description:
Found by the usage-rules cold test (defk-djy.18). In a module with `use Defk`, `@doc "..."` written before a `defk` is not attached to the kernel's function: Code.fetch_docs shows the kernel with doc :none, and the @doc moves to the next def (Elixir warns 'redefining @doc attribute previously set at line N' when that def has its own @doc). Repro: defmodule D do use Defk; @doc "one"; defk one(x :: i64) :: i64, do: x + 1; @doc "plain"; def plain, do: 1 end -> one/1 doc :none.

Fix: the def that defk generates for the kernel takes the pending @doc (and @spec?). When fixed, remove the line about it from usage-rules.md ("A `@doc` before `defk` is not attached yet") and add a test.
title: @doc before defk is lost: the kernel's function has no doc
